apps.short_description: Buge Files is a modern Android file manager built with Material Design 3 Expressive.
apps.description:
Buge Files is a modern Android file manager designed for efficient file browsing and storage management. Built with Material Design 3 Expressive, it provides a clean, intuitive, system-themed interface for managing files on your device.

The application lets you browse internal storage, open folders, navigate through the file system, and view file details such as size and modification date. Files and folders are presented in a modern card-style layout that makes everyday file management clear and convenient.

Smart categories provide quick access to common file types. Images include JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP and HEIC files. Videos include MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WMV, FLV and WebM files. Music includes MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG and M4A files. Documents include PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, TXT and MD files. Archive support covers ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZ and BZ2 files. Android application packages are also identified as APK files.

Buge Files includes a storage overview with visual progress indicators to help you understand storage usage. The settings area supports multiple languages, light, dark and system-default themes, and a control for displaying hidden files and folders.

Privacy and security are core principles of Buge Files. It keeps file access on your device, requests no unnecessary permissions, and helps you organize files clearly for better privacy management.

Buge Files requires Android 8.0, API level 26, or later. The project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

apps.short_description: Merge source code files from any project into a single text file for analysis, backup, and sharing
apps.description:
Code Integrator is an Android utility app that merges source code files from any project folder into a single, well-organized text file. It simplifies code analysis, backup, and sharing by consolidating your entire project's source into one portable file.

Features

- Merge all source files into one text file for easy review and sharing
- Project tree structure viewer with visual hierarchy
- Custom file type filters to exclude images, audio, video, archives, binaries, and more
- Auto-exclude build and .gradle folders to keep output clean
- File size ranking to quickly spot large files
- Material Design 3 UI with light and dark theme support

Supported File Types

Included: .java, .kt, .xml, .gradle, .txt, .md, .json, .sh, .bat, .gitignore
Excluded by default: .jpg, .png, .mp3, .mp4, .zip, .exe, .pdf, .doc, .class, and more

Output Format

The generated file includes:
- Project tree structure with folder and file icons
- Complete content of each text file
- File size ranking for quick identification of large files

Note: Storage permission is required to access project folders.

License: GNU General Public License v3.0

apps.short_description: A privacy-first Android music and video player with local and network playback
apps.description:
Buge Player is a polished, privacy-first Android music and video player built with Kotlin, AndroidX Media3, and Material Design 3 Expressive. It combines local and network media playback with a modern interface, dynamic artwork colors, multilingual support, and a standalone floating player for media opened from other applications.

Features

- Local and Network Media: Play local audio and video, HTTP/HTTPS progressive media, and HLS/M3U8 streams.

- Music Playback: Full Now Playing experience with queue management, shuffle, repeat modes, speed control, favourites, recent media, notification controls, and lock screen playback controls.

- Video Playback: Embedded video, immersive full-screen mode, elevated seek controls, automatic control hiding, and first-frame extraction for artwork and dynamic colors.

- Open with Buge Player: Open compatible audio and video from file managers, galleries, and other apps through ACTION_VIEW in a standalone floating player.

- Personalization: Material Design 3 Expressive UI, dynamic artwork colors, preset accents, light/dark/system themes, and Google Sans Flex typography.

- Languages: English, French, German, Russian, Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean.

Privacy

- No advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, account sign-in, or cloud backend.
- Favourites, queue entries, language selection, theme settings, and recent media remain on the device.
- Device media permission is requested only when the user scans the library.

License: GNU General Public License v3.0

apps.short_description: An application management tool that obtains adb shell privileges via Shizuku
apps.description:
Buge App Manager is a powerful Android utility application designed for advanced app and permission management. Built with Material Design 3, it offers a modern and intuitive interface for granular control over your device.

Features

- Shizuku Integration: Operates with Shizuku authorization for elevated control without requiring root.

- App Management: Browse and manage both user-installed and system applications with ease.

- Material Design 3 UI: Clean, system-themed interface that follows the latest Android design guidelines.

Permission Manager

- View and modify app permissions by category
- Supported categories include: Microphone, Camera, Location access, Notifications, Phone & Contacts, Storage and other
- Filter permissions by granted or denied status
- Batch permission operations for multiple apps

Privacy & Security

- Quickly identify which apps have access to sensitive permissions
- Optimize your device's security posture with clear permission insights

Note: Shizuku is required for advanced permission management features.

apps.short_description: Shizuku allows apps to use system APIs directly with adb/root privileges.
apps.description:
Shizuku is an Android application that enables other applications to utilize system APIs directly, either with root privileges or through ADB (Android Debug Bridge). It provides a secure and efficient way for apps to perform privileged operations without requiring full root access for the user.

This tool is essential for developers and advanced users who need to extend the functionality of their Android devices beyond standard app permissions. It achieves this by running a Shizuku server process that acts as an intermediary, forwarding system API calls from client applications.

Key features include:
- Securely granting system API access to non-root applications.
- Support for ADB-based activation, eliminating the need for root on newer Android versions.
- Enhanced control over device functionalities for advanced customization.
- A robust framework for developing powerful Android utilities.

License: Apache License 2.0
